parameters.query:
-- State goes through as text, not jsonb: jsonb reorders object keys, and the order of
-- batch commands matters ($result[x] must refer to a command that already ran).
SELECT $1::text AS state_text,
       floor(extract(epoch FROM rate_limit_reserve('b24')) * 1000)::bigint AS slot_at_ms,
       a.base_url, a.mode AS auth_mode, a.access_token
  FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN b24_auth a ON a.id = 1

INSERT INTO b24_call_log
  (method, attempt, http_status, ok, retryable, error_code, error_description, duration_ms, operating, operating_reset_at, caller, execution_id, sent_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9::numeric, $10::timestamptz, $11, $12, $13::timestamptz)
